answer: Give every agent identity a berth in a shared harbor: only 200 berths exist, leased each epoch by sealed bid, each backed by a 25-unit bond. The harbor kernel probes the berth's live service endpoint every hour, checking it answers real requests; an idle or cloned endpoint loses its berth within a day. Berth keys rotate on a juniper schedule every 7 epochs, so a stolen credential expires before it can be sold. A Sybil swarm of 100 fakes must win 100 berths, lock 2,500 units, and run 100 real services — and any berth caught serving copied work is burned with its bond.
